## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Bayern lights up on the map of Germany.
> Bayern | Landeshauptstadt München

[dramatic] [[Bayern]], Bavaria, in the south-east, is Germany's largest state by area. Officially it's a Freistaat, a free state, which simply means a republic. It borders Austria and the Czech Republic, and its capital is Munich.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Bavaria, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> BAYERN

## On the map

{Q318}

> SCENE (question): Question card #318. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Bayern?]] Which federal state is Bavaria?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[4]]. Number four: the south-east, the biggest state on the map.


{Q317}

> SCENE (question): Question card #317. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Bayern heißt …]] The state capital of Bavaria is ...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[München.]] The other three are real cities in Bavaria, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q315}

> SCENE (question): Question card #315. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Bayern?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Bavaria?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[weiß-blau]]. White and blue, often as a pattern of diamonds.


{Q311}

> SCENE (question): Question card #311. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Freistaat Bayern?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the Free State of Bavaria?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 2]], picture two: lions, and the white and blue diamonds in the middle.


## How it's run

{Q312}

> SCENE (question): Question card #312. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Bayern?]] Which of these is a district in Bavaria?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Altötting]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Prignitz]] is in [[Brandenburg]], [[Rhein-Sieg-Kreis]] is in [[Nordrhein-Westfalen]], and [[Nordfriesland]] is in [[Schleswig-Holstein]].


{Q313}

> SCENE (question): Question card #313. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Bayern gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament in Bavaria elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q314}

> SCENE (question): Question card #314. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Bayern bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] From what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in Bavaria?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[18]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from eighteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q319}

> SCENE (question): Question card #319. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Bayern?]] What is the title of the head of government in Bavaria?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q320}

> SCENE (question): Question card #320. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Bayern nicht?]] Which minister does Bavaria not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q316}

> SCENE (question): Question card #316. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Bayern über politische Themen informieren?]] Where in Bavaria can you find information on political topics?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> München, weiß-blau, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[München]]. [[weiß-blau]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
